definitions.explanation: A structure or barrier that encloses or surrounds an area. Can refer to fences, pens for animals, walled-off areas, or partitions.

examples.japanese: {動物|どうぶつ}の{囲|かこ}いを{修理|しゅうり}する。
{囲|かこ}いの{中|なか}で{鶏|にわとり}が{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: Chickens are running around inside the enclosure.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}の{周|まわ}りに{囲|かこ}いが{設|もう}けられている。
examples.english: A fence has been set up around the construction site.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from the verb {囲|かこ}う (to surround, to enclose). Can refer to physical barriers of various kinds — fences, pens, walls, partitions, or hoarding around construction sites.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {囲|かこ}いを{作|つく}る: to build an enclosure
- {囲|かこ}いの{中|なか}: inside the enclosure
- {囲|かこ}いを{設|もう}ける: to set up a fence/barrier
